newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to convert Moroccan debt into investments.
newsitem.headline: Spain to convert Moroccan debt into investments.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato will tomorrow sign a deal with Moroccan Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj to convert part of the debt the African country owes Spain into private investments, a note said on Monday.
The government said the agreement will allow Spanish investors interested in Moroccan projects to finance them via this debt, which they can buy at a discount to face value.
The agreement comprises 625 billion pesetas out of a total outstanding of $1.36 billion at the end of June 1996.
